author: tlindle
text: Only trade of the week for me. Spent a lot of time learning and tripping out backtesting the quasi pattern. I'm pretty sure you could make money just trading quasi's in good HTF locations. Anyways this quasimoto didn't play out perfectly, price wanted to tap the trendline, but still a good trade. I've noticed that a lot of times in addition to being at a HTF level, a quasimoto will provide a lower time frame S/D level at the H/L for you to get in on. The win rate on those trades is extremely high. Anyways, holding for lower trendline/demand target

author: Emene
text: Very nice!!! Well done. You know, always keep in mind that supply and demand is the main and almost only thing. Patterns give shape to the human psychology behind price action but eventually it is all about price travelling between offers and bids. In your trade the biggets fall was the first visit to a freshly created H4 supply area. Have a great week end.
